conf.description: GitLab (self-managed) gitlab-shell / logrus text (syslog-kv): KV-extract the space-separated key=value line, then feed the identical json-form normalisation - user_id prefix strip, duration to nanoseconds, correlation_id to event.id/trace.id, batched clean-path rename - since logrus text mode emits byte-identical key names to the JSON form.

conf.comment: gitlab-self-managed / gitlab-shell / syslog-kv (gitlab-shell.log with log_format: text). Per the work order's fields_omitted note, logrus's text formatter emits the exact same key names as the JSON form, just as one line of space-separated key=value tokens instead of a JSON object - so this pipeline is a KV extractor in front of the same normalisation the json format uses (user_id prefix strip, duration_ms to nanoseconds, correlation_id copied to event.id/trace.id). Quoted values with embedded spaces (msg, gl_project_path) are the parser's main hazard; serde's kvp extractor is used rather than a naive split. Same source-IP gap as the json form: no client IP in this feed.

functions.description: record approach: KV extraction feeding the json form's normalisation
tokenize the logrus text-mode key=value line into the same field names the JSON form carries
identical derivation to the json form's eval step, run against the KV-tokenized fields
identical batched rename to the json form
